summary: Frontend-only testing completed for age gate, onboarding guided flow, optional PDF upload behavior, terms 18+ text, and onboarding persistence to check-in after re-login.

ui_bugs.component: Global interactive elements (Auth, AgeGate, ConsentGate, Onboarding, Check-in, Settings)
ui_bugs.issue: Missing testID/data-testid attributes on buttons, inputs, checkboxes, selects and file input, causing brittle automation and violating required testability standard.

integration_issues.issue: Supabase REST request logs a 400 during age confirmation before fallback path succeeds; user flow continues but noisy error remains in console/network.

issues: Button minimum height is 42px in CSS; target mobile touch minimum is 44px.

action_items: Add stable testID/data-testid attributes to all interactive and critical status elements.
Remove/avoid 400 on age confirmation when migration is missing (pre-check columns or RPC guard) to keep clean telemetry.
Increase primary/ghost/toggle button minimum touch target from 42px to at least 44px.
critical_code_review_comments: No data-testid strategy in key flows (auth/onboarding/check-in/settings), reducing regression reliability.
confirmAge currently depends on fail-then-fallback behavior that emits visible 400 errors in console.
seed_data_creation: No new seed created. Used existing credentials from /app/memory/test_credentials.md (agegate1779225070@test.com).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Tested on mobile viewport 375x667 via http://127.0.0.1:3000. agegate1779225070@test.com is now age-confirmed, consented, onboarding completed, and lands on check-in after login.
rca_of_issue: 400 during age confirmation comes from profiles update call against environment where age columns may be absent; code then falls back to onboarding JSON update and succeeds. Mitigation: avoid intentional failing write path by checking schema capability first or routing to a guarded server-side operation.
